name: devagent
description: DevAgent: guardrails, engineering standards and a delivery workflow for Claude Code.

plugins.name: devagent-standards
plugins.description: Engineering standards as thirteen on-demand skills: auth, API, browser and LLM security; encryption; cloud infrastructure and cost; stack selection; observability; document artifacts; breach response; verification methods; engagement close-out; public release. Plus devagent-guard hooks enforcing the toolchain rules (deny or ask).

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: A delivery workflow: load, brainstorm, design, research, spec-panel, workflow, build, plan and save, each writing a markdown record of one feature. Build executes the plan one task at a time and ticks a task only with recorded verification evidence.
